_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE sizing policy. Hard caps live in config/protected.json and always win.
sizing_notes: Flat $5. min_edge 0.04 since the data-collection phase. Edge-scaled, Kelly and price-tiered sizing all lowered the held-out replay score (strategy/policy.py notes). Full history: strategy/playbook-reference.md Appendix A.
edge_class_notes: min_edge_book_devig 0.07 applies to edges that come only from devigging sportsbook odds against a PM book (0/7 era of proportional devig, then 2W/0L after the power-devig fix; clean-feed edges sit at ~0.02, so the floor is rarely binding). Structural/other edges keep min_edge 0.04. max_spread 0.06 is a hard veto except the narrow info-race wide-book exception at ask-edge >= min_edge_wide_book 0.30 (playbook 2.5). max_stake_per_event_usd caps correlated legs on one real-world trigger (playbook 2.8). The >0.10 outside-view veto and the mechanical-econ carve-out live in playbook 2.2-2.3. Change a number here only with settled evidence cited in a retro; do not append history here (it goes in the retro). Last review DEEP-2026-09-29: no numeric changes. Full history: strategy/playbook-reference.md Appendix A.
